policy: Every divergence is registered here with a direction and rationale. 'ours-stricter' means this implementation rejects input the reference text parser accepts; the reference rejects these later (at component encoding) or has since removed the syntax. No 'ours-more-permissive' divergence is allowed.

i05-dup-field.rationale: duplicate record field names; the reference `component wit` text path prints them, while the component encoder rejects them. INV-11 fails closed at parse time (E-DUP-MEMBER).

i21-dup-case.rationale: duplicate enum case names; same reasoning as i05 (E-DUP-MEMBER).

i17-named-results.rationale: named/multiple function results; still accepted by wasm-tools 1.219.1 but removed from the WIT specification afterwards. The declared feature level excludes them (E-PARSE-UNSUPPORTED).
